correctness.rationale: The exact binomial propagator gives E||X_n||²=|x1|²q_a^n+|x2|²q_b^n. F_c(u)=u(1-e^{-c/u}) is strictly increasing; thus q_a decreases and q_b increases in p, their crossing uniquely minimizes the max, and at p=1/2 the faster mode q_a<q_b. The rare-event scaling follows by monotone inversion p_h/h->kappa; Bin(n_h,p_h) converges to Poisson(kappa T), whose nonconstant fast multiplier gives positive nonconsistency error. Uniform fixed-p LLN recovers deterministic limit. Large-h crossing expansion checked separately. Independent small-h grid and explicit finite switching-word checks corroborated but do not prove the all-real assertions.
